keyPoints.en: An independence mission went to London (18 January – 8 February 1956): four representatives of the Malay rulers and four of the Alliance, led by Tunku Abdul Rahman.
keyPoints.bm: Rombongan kemerdekaan ke London (18 Januari – 8 Februari 1956): empat wakil raja-raja Melayu dan empat wakil Perikatan, diketuai Tunku Abdul Rahman.

keyPoints.en: The London Agreement (8 February 1956) agreed that Malaya would be independent on 31 August 1957 if possible.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian London (8 Februari 1956) bersetuju Tanah Melayu akan merdeka pada 31 Ogos 1957 jika boleh.

keyPoints.en: On his return, Tunku announced the date at Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka, on 20 February 1956.
keyPoints.bm: Sekembalinya, Tunku mengumumkan tarikh itu di Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka, pada 20 Februari 1956.

meaning.en: 8 February 1956 agreement between Britain and the Malayan delegation on the path to independence.
meaning.bm: Perjanjian 8 Februari 1956 antara British dengan rombongan Tanah Melayu tentang jalan ke arah kemerdekaan.

meaning.en: Authority given by voters — the Alliance's 1955 win gave Tunku a mandate to negotiate.
meaning.bm: Kuasa yang diberi pengundi — kemenangan Perikatan 1955 memberi Tunku mandat untuk berunding.

heading.en: a. Why rulers and the Alliance negotiated together
heading.bm: a. Kepentingan rundingan bersama wakil raja dan Perikatan

points.en: A united team showed Britain that the rulers and the people agreed on independence.
points.bm: Pasukan yang bersatu membuktikan kepada British bahawa raja-raja dan rakyat sependapat tentang kemerdekaan.

heading.en: b. What was agreed in London
heading.bm: b. Perkara yang dipersetujui di London

points.en: Independence on 31 August 1957 if possible.
points.bm: Kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957 jika boleh.

points.en: An independent commission to draft the constitution (the Reid Commission).
points.bm: Sebuah suruhanjaya bebas menggubal perlembagaan (Suruhanjaya Reid).

points.en: Internal security, defence and finance to be handed over gradually; Malayanisation of the civil service; Malaya to stay in the Commonwealth.
points.bm: Keselamatan dalam negeri, pertahanan dan kewangan diserahkan secara berperingkat; Malayanisasi perkhidmatan awam; Tanah Melayu kekal dalam Komanwel.

points.en: 20 February 1956: crowds at Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka, heard Tunku announce the independence date.
points.bm: 20 Februari 1956: orang ramai di Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka, mendengar Tunku mengumumkan tarikh kemerdekaan.

points.en: Melaka was chosen because it was the centre of the Malay Sultanate that fell to the Portuguese in 1511.
points.bm: Melaka dipilih kerana ia pusat Kesultanan Melayu yang jatuh ke tangan Portugis pada 1511.

event.en: London talks begin at Lancaster House.
event.bm: Rundingan London bermula di Lancaster House.

event.en: Announcement at Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka.
event.bm: Pengumuman di Padang Bandar Hilir, Melaka.

alt.en: A 1957 stamp showing Tunku and the crowd awaiting his return from the London talks.
alt.bm: Setem 1957 menunjukkan Tunku dan orang ramai menanti kepulangannya dari rundingan London.

caption.en: A 1957 stamp showing Tunku and the crowd awaiting his return from the London talks.
caption.bm: Setem 1957 menunjukkan Tunku dan orang ramai menanti kepulangannya dari rundingan London.

question.en: Why was Melaka chosen for the announcement of the independence date?
question.bm: Mengapakah Melaka dipilih untuk pengumuman tarikh kemerdekaan?

answer.en: Melaka was where the Malay Sultanate lost its freedom to the Portuguese in 1511, so announcing freedom there was a powerful symbol.
answer.bm: Melaka ialah tempat Kesultanan Melayu kehilangan kebebasan kepada Portugis pada 1511, maka mengumumkan kemerdekaan di sana menjadi lambang yang bermakna.

keyPoints.en: The Federation of Malaya Constitutional Commission (Reid Commission) was set up in 1956 to draft the constitution.
keyPoints.bm: Suruhanjaya Perlembagaan Persekutuan Tanah Melayu (Suruhanjaya Reid) ditubuhkan pada 1956 untuk menggubal perlembagaan.

keyPoints.en: Members: Lord Reid (chairman) and Sir Ivor Jennings (Britain), Sir William McKell (Australia), B. Malik (India) and Justice Abdul Hamid (Pakistan).
keyPoints.bm: Anggota: Lord Reid (pengerusi) dan Sir Ivor Jennings (Britain), Sir William McKell (Australia), B. Malik (India) dan Hakim Abdul Hamid (Pakistan).

keyPoints.en: It studied 131 memoranda — the Alliance memorandum was the most important.
keyPoints.bm: Ia meneliti 131 memorandum — memorandum Perikatan ialah yang paling penting.

meaning.en: The instructions that set what the commission had to do.
A written proposal sent to the commission.
meaning.bm: Cadangan bertulis yang dihantar kepada suruhanjaya.

meaning.en: Association of Britain and its former colonies — the members came from Commonwealth countries to be neutral.
meaning.bm: Pertubuhan Britain dan bekas tanah jajahannya — anggota dipilih dari negara Komanwel supaya berkecuali.

points.en: Parliamentary democracy with two houses.
points.bm: Demokrasi berparlimen dengan dua dewan.

points.en: A strong central government with some autonomy for the states.
points.bm: Kerajaan pusat yang kuat dengan sedikit autonomi bagi negeri.

points.en: Protect the position and prestige of the Malay rulers; a Head of State chosen from among them.
points.bm: Melindungi kedudukan dan kemuliaan raja-raja Melayu; Ketua Negara dipilih dalam kalangan mereka.

points.en: A common nationality for the whole Federation.
points.bm: Kewarganegaraan bersama bagi seluruh Persekutuan.

points.en: Safeguard the special position of the Malays and the legitimate interests of other communities.
points.bm: Menjaga kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu dan kepentingan sah kaum lain.

points.en: Held meetings in Malaya (from June 1956), received 131 memoranda from parties, groups and individuals.
points.bm: Mengadakan mesyuarat di Tanah Melayu (mulai Jun 1956), menerima 131 memorandum daripada parti, pertubuhan dan individu.

points.en: Wrote its report in Rome; the Reid Report was published in February 1957.
points.bm: Menulis laporannya di Rom; Laporan Reid diterbitkan pada Februari 1957.

points.en: Five legal experts from Commonwealth countries, chosen so the commission would be neutral.
points.bm: Lima pakar undang-undang dari negara Komanwel, dipilih supaya suruhanjaya berkecuali.

question.en: Why was the Alliance memorandum important to the Reid Commission?
question.bm: Mengapakah memorandum Perikatan penting kepada Suruhanjaya Reid?

answer.en: It recorded a compromise already agreed by UMNO, MCA and MIC on citizenship, special position, religion and language, so it showed what all the main races could accept.
answer.bm: Ia mencatat kompromi yang sudah dipersetujui UMNO, MCA dan MIC tentang kewarganegaraan, kedudukan istimewa, agama dan bahasa, maka ia menunjukkan apa yang boleh diterima semua kaum utama.

keyPoints.en: The Reid Report was studied by a Working Committee of representatives of the rulers, the Alliance and the British government.
keyPoints.bm: Laporan Reid dikaji oleh Jawatankuasa Kerja yang terdiri daripada wakil raja-raja, Perikatan dan kerajaan British.

keyPoints.en: After changes, the draft was approved at a conference in London (May 1957).
keyPoints.bm: Selepas pindaan, draf diluluskan dalam persidangan di London (Mei 1957).

keyPoints.en: It was passed by the Conference of Rulers, the Federal Legislative Council and the British Parliament.
keyPoints.bm: Ia diluluskan oleh Majlis Raja-Raja, Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan dan Parlimen British.

keyPoints.en: The Constitution came into force on 27 August 1957; independence followed on 31 August 1957.
keyPoints.bm: Perlembagaan berkuat kuasa pada 27 Ogos 1957; kemerdekaan menyusul pada 31 Ogos 1957.

meaning.en: A first written version that can still be changed.
meaning.bm: Versi bertulis awal yang masih boleh dipinda.

meaning.en: Committee that reviewed and amended the Reid Report.
meaning.bm: Jawatankuasa yang mengkaji dan meminda Laporan Reid.

points.en: 1. Reid Commission collects views and writes its report (1956 – Feb 1957).
points.bm: 1. Suruhanjaya Reid mengumpul pandangan dan menulis laporan (1956 – Feb 1957).

points.en: 2. Working Committee studies and amends the report.
points.bm: 2. Jawatankuasa Kerja mengkaji dan meminda laporan.

points.en: 3. Final talks in London (May 1957).
points.bm: 3. Rundingan akhir di London (Mei 1957).

points.en: 4. Approval by the Conference of Rulers, the Federal Legislative Council and the British Parliament.
points.bm: 4. Kelulusan Majlis Raja-Raja, Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan dan Parlimen British.

points.en: 5. The Federation of Malaya Agreement 1957 is signed (5 August 1957); the Constitution takes effect on 27 August 1957.
points.bm: 5. Perjanjian Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1957 ditandatangani (5 Ogos 1957); Perlembagaan berkuat kuasa pada 27 Ogos 1957.

question.en: Arrange the main steps in making the 1957 Constitution.

answer.en: London Agreement → Reid Commission and memoranda → Reid Report → Working Committee amendments → approvals → Federation of Malaya Agreement and Constitution in force.
answer.bm: Perjanjian London → Suruhanjaya Reid dan memorandum → Laporan Reid → pindaan Jawatankuasa Kerja → kelulusan → Perjanjian Persekutuan Tanah Melayu dan Perlembagaan berkuat kuasa.

keyPoints.en: The Federation of Malaya Agreement 1957 was signed on 5 August 1957 by the Malay rulers and the British High Commissioner, Sir Donald MacGillivray.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1957 ditandatangani pada 5 Ogos 1957 oleh raja-raja Melayu dan Pesuruhjaya Tinggi British, Sir Donald MacGillivray.

keyPoints.en: Its core: constitutional monarchy and parliamentary democracy, citizenship, the special position of the Malays and legitimate interests of others, the position of Islam, and the position of the Malay language.
keyPoints.bm: Inti patinya: raja berperlembagaan dan demokrasi berparlimen, kewarganegaraan, kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu dan kepentingan sah kaum lain, kedudukan agama Islam, dan kedudukan bahasa Melayu.

keyPoints.en: The give-and-take between the races is often called the social contract (kontrak sosial).
keyPoints.bm: Tolak ansur antara kaum ini sering dipanggil kontrak sosial.

meaning.en: The King and rulers act according to the Constitution.
meaning.bm: Yang di-Pertuan Agong dan raja-raja bertindak mengikut Perlembagaan.

meaning.en: Government formed by the party with a majority of elected members of Parliament.
meaning.bm: Kerajaan dibentuk oleh parti yang mendapat majoriti ahli Parlimen yang dipilih.

meaning.en: Agreement: non-Malays get citizenship; Malays' special position, Islam and the Malay language are protected.
meaning.bm: Persetujuan: bukan Melayu mendapat kewarganegaraan; kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu, Islam dan bahasa Melayu dilindungi.

meaning.en: Special position of the Malays (and later the natives of Sabah and Sarawak).
meaning.bm: Kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu (dan kemudian bumiputera Sabah dan Sarawak).

heading.en: a. Constitutional monarchy and parliamentary democracy
heading.bm: a. Raja berperlembagaan dan demokrasi berparlimen

points.en: The Yang di-Pertuan Agong is Head of State, chosen by the Conference of Rulers for five years.
points.bm: Yang di-Pertuan Agong ialah Ketua Negara, dipilih oleh Majlis Raja-Raja untuk lima tahun.

points.en: Parliament: Dewan Rakyat (elected) and Dewan Negara; the Prime Minister leads the government.
points.bm: Parlimen: Dewan Rakyat (dipilih) dan Dewan Negara; Perdana Menteri mengetuai kerajaan.

points.en: The Constitution is the supreme law (Article 4).
points.bm: Perlembagaan ialah undang-undang tertinggi (Perkara 4).

points.en: By operation of law, registration or naturalisation; jus soli for those born on or after Merdeka Day.
points.bm: Melalui kuat kuasa undang-undang, pendaftaran atau penaturalisasian; jus soli bagi yang lahir pada atau selepas Hari Merdeka.

heading.en: c. Special position of the Malays and legitimate interests of others
heading.bm: c. Kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu dan kepentingan sah kaum lain

points.en: Article 153: quotas in the civil service, scholarships, permits and education — while protecting other communities' legitimate interests.
points.bm: Perkara 153: kuota dalam perkhidmatan awam, biasiswa, permit dan pendidikan — sambil melindungi kepentingan sah kaum lain.

points.en: Article 3: Islam is the religion of the Federation; other religions may be practised in peace and harmony (Article 11 guarantees freedom of religion).
points.bm: Perkara 3: Islam agama Persekutuan; agama lain boleh diamalkan dengan aman dan damai (Perkara 11 menjamin kebebasan beragama).

heading.en: e. Position of the Malay language

points.en: Article 152: Malay is the national language; English was allowed as an official language for at least 10 years; other languages may be used and learned.
points.bm: Perkara 152: bahasa Melayu bahasa kebangsaan; bahasa Inggeris dibenarkan sebagai bahasa rasmi sekurang-kurangnya 10 tahun; bahasa lain boleh digunakan dan dipelajari.

question.en: Why is the social contract important for stability?
question.bm: Mengapakah kontrak sosial penting untuk kestabilan?

answer.en: Each community gave and received something — citizenship for non-Malays; protection of the Malays' position, Islam and Malay. Respecting this compromise keeps harmony between races.
answer.bm: Setiap kaum memberi dan menerima — kewarganegaraan bagi bukan Melayu; perlindungan kedudukan orang Melayu, Islam dan bahasa Melayu. Menghormati kompromi ini mengekalkan keharmonian kaum.

tip.en: Five core elements: Raja berperlembagaan & demokrasi, Kewarganegaraan, Kedudukan istimewa, Islam, Bahasa Melayu.
tip.bm: Lima inti pati: Raja berperlembagaan & demokrasi, Kewarganegaraan, Kedudukan istimewa, Islam, Bahasa Melayu.
